title: Jesus... I Flinched When Things Went Right. 🌤️
topic: after a year of bracing for bad news she trained herself to look down, and this week when good things finally started moving she almost looked away

bible.text: And when these things begin to come to pass, then look up, and lift up your heads; for your redemption draweth nigh.

lines.speaker: person
lines.text: Jesus... I've been looking down so long, I flinched when things went right. 🌤️

lines.speaker: person
lines.text: The call came. The report came. My first thought was, what goes wrong next?

lines.speaker: jesus
lines.text: You braced for the storm so long, you forgot storms end.

lines.speaker: person
lines.text: But last time it started turning, it turned right back. I can't carry another almost.

lines.speaker: jesus
lines.text: A season turning is a signal, not a trick. When things begin to move, lift your head.

lines.speaker: jesus
lines.text: Lifting your head isn't forgetting the past. It's reading the sky.

lines.speaker: engagement
lines.text: Send this to someone waiting for the other shoe. 👟
